about: The agent's own browser tab: a page in the Copilot pool's browser (same sign-in), shown as its own window. See docs\AGENT.md.

tools.name: browser_open
tools.title: Open your browser tab
tools.description: Opens (or brings up) your own browser tab in a window on my screen, optionally going to an address. It shares my work sign-in, so work sites may open signed in. Returns a snapshot of the page (see browser_snapshot). https only.

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.title: Go to an address
tools.description: Loads an address in your browser tab and returns a snapshot of the page. https only.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.title: Read the page
tools.description: Reads your browser tab: title, address, how far it is scrolled, a numbered list of the things you can use ([ref] kind "label", with values, checked/disabled/off-screen) and the page's text. Use the ref numbers with the other browser tools. Refs change whenever you take a new snapshot or an action returns one: always use the latest.

textChars.description: How much page text to include (default 4000, 0 = only the list)

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.title: Look at the page
tools.description: A screenshot of the visible part of your browser tab, attached as an image. 1 image pixel = 1 page pixel, so you can click x/y read off it (useful for things the snapshot doesn't list, e.g. inside frames or canvases).

tools.name: browser_click
tools.title: Click on the page
tools.description: Clicks an element of your browser tab (ref from the latest snapshot), or a point x/y (page pixels, from a screenshot). button: left (default), right (opens the page's right-click menu if it has one) or middle; double: true for a double-click. Returns a new snapshot.

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.title: Drag on the page
tools.description: Presses the left mouse button on one thing and drags it to another, then lets go: move cards or rows, slide a slider, select text, pan a map, draw. Start: from (ref) or fromX/fromY; end: to (ref) or toX/toY (page pixels, e.g. read off a screenshot). Returns a new snapshot.

to.description: Ref of where to drop it

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.title: Point the mouse at something
tools.description: Moves the mouse over an element (ref) or point (x/y) without clicking - for menus that open on hover or tooltips. Returns a new snapshot.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.title: Type on the page
tools.description: Clicks into a field (ref, optional: without it types where the cursor is), replaces what's in it (clear: false to add to it instead) with text, and presses Enter if submit is true. Returns a new snapshot.

tools.name: browser_key
tools.title: Press a key
tools.description: Presses a key or shortcut in your browser tab: Enter, Tab, Shift+Tab, Escape, Backspace, Delete, Space, ArrowUp/Down/Left/Right, Home, End, PageUp, PageDown, F5, a letter, or Ctrl+<letter>. Returns a new snapshot.

tools.name: browser_select
tools.title: Pick from a dropdown
tools.description: Picks an option (its text or value) in a dropdown list (a 'select' in the snapshot). For custom dropdowns that aren't 'select', click them instead. Returns a new snapshot.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.title: Scroll the page
tools.description: Scrolls your browser tab (or the scrollable box under ref) down, up, left or right by amount pixels (default 600). Returns a new snapshot.

tools.name: browser_back
tools.title: Go back
tools.description: Goes back to the previous page in your browser tab (direction: forward to go forward again). Returns a new snapshot.
